features.aiImages: AI images (photo enhance / text to image)

hints.basePlatforms: RedNote has no auto-publishing API, so you download the image and copy the caption, then post in the app
hints.monthlyCredits: A template image is 1 credit; AI images are 1 credit standard, 2 credits HD

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What happens to unused monthly credits?
faq.a1: Monthly credits reset at the end of each period. Top-up credits never expire and are used once the monthly credits run out.
faq.q2: Can I add just one platform?
faq.a2: Yes. The base plan covers Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and RedNote; other platforms are added one at a time.
faq.a3: Once we set up your custom plan, pay by card on your Membership page (EUR or CAD). It renews monthly and you can cancel anytime. Offline payment works too.
faq.a4: No. If an AI generation fails or is blocked by moderation, the credits are refunded automatically.

bottom.title: Not sure which tier fits?
bottom.body: Tell us where you post and roughly how much each month, and we'll send you a quote.
